// Documentación oficial que siguen los agentes. Para agregar una página: una fila más.
// Se guarda en tu repo (__GITHUB_REPO__) → docs-oficiales/<area>/<id>.md
const F = [
  ['meta', 'limites-de-uso', 'Límites de uso de la Marketing API', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/overview/rate-limiting'],
  ['meta', 'changelog-marketing-api', 'Changelog de la Marketing API', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/marketing-api-changelog'],
  ['meta', 'changelog-graph-api', 'Changelog de la Graph API (versiones y retiros)', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog'],
  ['meta', 'campana', 'Referencia: Campaign', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-campaign-group'],
  ['meta', 'conjunto', 'Referencia: Ad Set', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-campaign'],
  ['meta', 'anuncio', 'Referencia: Ad', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/adgroup'],
  ['meta', 'creativo', 'Referencia: Ad Creative', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-creative'],
  ['meta', 'reglas-automaticas', 'Reglas automatizadas (Ad Rule)', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-rule/'],
  ['meta', 'insights', 'Insights API', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/insights'],
  ['meta', 'categoria-especial', 'Categorías especiales de anuncios', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/audiences/special-ad-category'],
  ['meta', 'publicos-personalizados', 'Públicos personalizados', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/audiences/guides/custom-audiences'],
  ['meta', 'lead-ads', 'Lead Ads (formularios instantáneos)', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/guides/lead-ads'],
  ['meta', 'conversions-api', 'Conversions API', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/conversions-api'],
  ['meta', 'conversions-api-deduplicacion', 'Conversions API: deduplicar píxel y servidor', 'https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/conversions-api/deduplicate-pixel-and-server-events'],
  ['meta', 'politicas-publicidad', 'Normas de publicidad de Meta', 'https://transparency.meta.com/policies/ad-standards/'],
  ['google', 'release-notes', 'Google Ads API: notas de versión', 'https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/release-notes'],
  ['google', 'fechas-de-retiro', 'Google Ads API: fechas de retiro de versiones', 'https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/sunset-dates'],
  ['google', 'niveles-de-acceso', 'Google Ads API: niveles de acceso', 'https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/api-policy/access-levels'],
  ['google', 'cuotas', 'Google Ads API: cuotas y límites', 'https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/best-practices/quotas'],
  ['google', 'campanas', 'Google Ads API: campañas', 'https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/campaigns/overview'],
  ['google', 'ideas-de-keywords', 'Google Ads API: ideas de palabras clave', 'https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/keyword-planning/generate-keyword-ideas'],
  ['google', 'recomendaciones', 'Google Ads API: recomendaciones', 'https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/recommendations'],
  ['google', 'cpa-objetivo', 'CPA objetivo (Target CPA)', 'https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/6268632?hl=es'],
  ['google', 'conversiones-mejoradas-leads', 'Conversiones mejoradas para leads', 'https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/15713840?hl=es'],
  ['google', 'anuncios-adaptables-busqueda', 'Anuncios de búsqueda adaptables', 'https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/7684791?hl=es'],
  ['google', 'politica-customer-match', 'Política: Customer Match', 'https://support.google.com/adspolicy/answer/6299717?hl=es'],
];
return F.map(([area, id, titulo, url]) => ({ json: { area, id, titulo, url, ruta: 'docs-oficiales/' + area + '/' + id + '.md' } }));
